PFS-15 landed the --force VOL_OP_REVOKE_HANDLE sweep but the only reachable arm today without a provisioned KIND_ELEVATE_CHANNEL cap is UR_RC_NO_ELEVATE (see umount.pdxfs STATUS.md L295). The UR_RC_OK + revoked_handles > 0 shape requires PFS-18 (elevate-channel broker-endpoint cap provision at shell session mint).
